from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    base=[]
    for c in range(w):
        vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        base.append(Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0])
    period=w
    for p in range(1,w+1):
        if all(base[c]==base[c%p] for c in range(w)):
            period=p
            break
    out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=[]
        for c in range(w):
            row.append(base[(c-1)%period] if c==r else base[c])
        out.append(row)
    return out
